title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal AI…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Drupal AI versions from 0.0.0 to 1.4.11 and from 1.5.0 to 1.5.2 due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This flaw could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by other users.
